hints.title: Delayed Execution Coalescing
hints.text: Frequent events like rapid key strokes should postpone actual execution until a period of silence occurs.

hints.title: Timer Reset Mechanics
hints.text: Store a timer reference in closure scope. Whenever the wrapped function is called, cancel any active timer with clearTimeout and schedule a fresh timeout.

hints.title: Closure Wrapper Blueprint
hints.text: Declare timerId in outer scope. Returned function accepts rest arguments (...args), cancels previous timerId, and assigns timerId = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), t).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.space: O(1) timer handle retained in closure
complexity.notes: Timer cancellation and recreation operate in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Executing on every event floods downstream handlers, network endpoints, or rendering engines.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant closure memory captures arguments and delays execution until trailing quiet window.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of rest arguments and lexical arrow function preservation of closure variables.
